author: Kai Moreno
title: Model fallback chain configuration
content:
# Purpose
How to set a fallback model when the primary returns 503. This is not what to do when a model is gone with HTTP 410.

# When to use
How to set a fallback model when the primary returns 503. This is not what to do when a model is gone with HTTP 410.

# What Support does
P4, Support. Send the fallback cookbook. If the primary returns HTTP 410 model_retired, stop and use the retired-model page, not this cookbook.

# Intake
Collect the customer, the project or pool name, the region if they named one, and the outcome they want. Write those on the SUP ticket before you route.

# Priority and routing
P4, Support. Send the fallback cookbook. If the primary returns HTTP 410 model_retired, stop and use the retired-model page, not this cookbook. If this page and a more specific SOP both apply, the more specific SOP wins.

# Guardrails
Do not issue credits. Do not disable an org API key from this page. Do not invent a label this page does not name.

# Customer reply
Thanks, we have the request. We will follow the internal playbook for this kind of ticket and update you on the SUP thread.

# Related
Support intake checklist. Severity matrix for anything that is actually down. This page is only for the purpose above.
